name: The Missing Ingredient
source:
Mavis Neela Berry is a baker in a small town. Nearly a year after breaking up with her last boyfriend, she’s given up on possibility of love. Instead, she sets her sights on winning the town’s country fair pie competition with her family recipe of blueberry pie. However, when a mysterious person shows up in her chicken coop, she recruits them as a new farm hand. Who are they, what is their story, and why do they act so strangely every time there’s a full moon in the sky? 

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/the-missing-ingredient]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅维斯·尼拉·贝瑞 (Mavis Neela Berry) 是小镇上的一名面包师。与上一个男友分手近一年后，她放弃了爱情的可能性。相反，她的目标是用她的家传蓝莓派食谱赢得镇上的乡村公平派比赛。然而，当一个神秘人出现在她的鸡舍时，她招募他们作为新的农场帮手。他们是谁，有什么故事，为什么每次满月时他们的行为都如此奇怪？

[来自[url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/the-missing-ingredient]itch.io[/url]]
